name: B. Welf
mentions: B. Welf, a well-known merchant of Deadwood, arrived Sunday morning. He has a large stock of millinery, fancy goods, dress goods etc., and intends to start into business as soon…
Welf, from Deadwood, has opened out a good stock of notions, dry goods and gents' furnishing goods in a tent nearly opposite this office. He reports a fair trade.
